question: Bisectors of angles B and C of a triangle ABC intersect at a point O. If ∠BOC = 105°, then ∠BAC is equal to :
solution:
**Concept used:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5524edf6884577a972366f4763b666aad37de2ce9eac0f2b0021fc01891ec4c8.png] 

In the ΔABC, if BO and CO are the angle bisectors, then ∠BOC = 90 + 1/2∠A

**Calculation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/de26a1195343f38d99407febd6bf9267f2d15c380795e8fc3612b9081fbeb1c0.png] 

According to the given concept,

∠BOC = 90 + 1/2∠BAC

⇒ 105 = 90 + 1/2∠BAC

⇒ 1/2∠BAC = 15

⇒ ∠BAC = 30° 

∴ The correct answer is 30°
